description: Flat metadata schema for individual protein–protein interaction records derived from co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry experiments in cancer cells, including bait, prey, experimental conditions, antibodies, and detection details.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record or interaction observation within the dataset.

experiment_id.descr: Identifier linking all records generated from the same biological experiment or MS run set.

sample_id.descr: Identifier for the specific biological sample, lysate, or IP preparation used for this record.

cell_line.descr: Cancer cell line used, for example 'MCF-7', 'A549', or 'HeLa'.

cell_type.descr: General cell type or lineage, for example epithelial, hematopoietic, or neuronal.

organism.descr: Source organism of the cells, typically 'Homo sapiens'.

disease_context.descr: Disease or cancer context, for example breast cancer, lung adenocarcinoma, or leukemia.

oncogenic_mutation.descr: Specific oncogenic mutation or alteration studied, for example 'KRAS G12D' or 'TP53 R175H'.

mutation_status.descr: Mutation status of the sample, such as wild-type, heterozygous, homozygous, overexpression, or knockout.

treatment_condition.descr: Experimental treatment or stimulation applied, for example drug, growth factor, hypoxia, or control.

treatment_concentration.descr: Treatment concentration, with units stated in the accompanying protocol or as numeric value if standardized.

treatment_duration_hours.descr: Duration of treatment before lysis or IP, in hours.

biological_replicate.descr: Biological replicate number for the sample.

technical_replicate.descr: Technical replicate number for the analytical run.

bait_protein_name.descr: Protein targeted for immunoprecipitation, also known as the bait protein.

bait_protein_id.descr: Stable identifier for the bait protein, such as UniProt accession or gene ID.

prey_protein_name.descr: Interacting protein identified in the MS readout, also known as the prey protein.

prey_protein_id.descr: Stable identifier for the prey protein, such as UniProt accession or gene ID.

interaction_type.descr: Type of interaction evidence, for example direct, complex-associated, or putative.

interaction_status.descr: Whether the interaction was detected, enriched, validated, or not detected in this record.

interaction_direction.descr: Directional role in the assay, typically bait-to-prey or co-associated complex member.

abundance_value.descr: Quantitative abundance for the prey or interaction signal, for example spectral count, LFQ intensity, or peak area.

abundance_unit.descr: Unit or measurement type for abundance_value, for example spectral count, intensity, or area.

fold_change.descr: Observed fold change versus the specified control condition, if applicable.

p_value.descr: Statistical significance value for the interaction or abundance change.

q_value.descr: Multiple-testing corrected significance value, such as FDR-adjusted p-value.

interaction_score.descr: Composite confidence or scoring metric assigned by the analysis pipeline.

confidence_level.descr: Confidence category for the interaction, such as high, medium, low, or validated.

antibody_name.descr: Name or vendor label of the antibody used for immunoprecipitation or detection.

antibody_target.descr: Target antigen recognized by the antibody.

antibody_catalog_number.descr: Catalog number or equivalent product identifier for the antibody.

antibody_host_species.descr: Host species in which the antibody was raised, for example rabbit, mouse, or goat.

immunoprecipitation_method.descr: IP approach used, for example co-IP, pull-down, tandem affinity purification, or controls.

lysis_buffer.descr: Composition or named formulation of the lysis buffer used for cell extraction.

wash_buffer.descr: Composition or named formulation of the wash buffer used during IP cleanup.

incubation_temperature_c.descr: Temperature during antibody incubation or complex capture, in degrees Celsius.

incubation_time_minutes.descr: Incubation time for capture or binding steps, in minutes.

detergent_used.descr: Primary detergent used in lysis or wash buffer, for example NP-40, Triton X-100, or SDS.

mass_spectrometry_platform.descr: MS platform or instrument model used for protein identification, for example Orbitrap or Q Exactive.

detection_method.descr: Analytical detection method, for example LC-MS/MS, MALDI-TOF, or label-free proteomics.

fragmentation_method.descr: MS/MS fragmentation method, for example HCD, CID, or ETD.

search_database.descr: Protein sequence database used for peptide/protein identification, for example UniProt human reference proteome.

database_version.descr: Version or release date of the database used for identification.

software_used.descr: Primary software used for peptide identification, quantification, or interaction calling.

fdr_threshold.descr: False discovery rate threshold used for peptide, protein, or interaction filtering, expressed as a fraction such as 0.01 for 1%.

peptide_count.descr: Number of unique peptides supporting identification of the prey protein.

unique_peptide_count.descr: Number of peptides unique to the prey protein or protein group.

coverage_percent.descr: Sequence coverage of the identified prey protein, as a percentage.

protein_group_id.descr: Protein group or cluster identifier assigned by the analysis pipeline.

validation_status.descr: Whether the interaction was independently validated, for example by reciprocal co-IP, western blot, or orthogonal assay.

validation_method.descr: Validation method used, if any, for example reciprocal IP, PLA, or proximity labeling.

control_sample_id.descr: Identifier of the matched control sample used for enrichment comparison.

control_type.descr: Type of control used, for example IgG control, bead-only control, or untreated control.

notes.descr: Free-text notes describing exceptions, protocol deviations, or important interpretation details.
